# CG-RES-008: Response type widened

A response value may have more JSON types.

**Why it matters:** Values of new types were not guaranteed before.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.typeChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {where} may now be {to} (was {from}).
>
> Consumers parsing the previous type may fail on values of the new types.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the previous type, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: integer → number

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: number}}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. GET /x: response 200 (application/json) may now be number (was integer).

### Fires: string → [string, integer]

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: [string, integer]}}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. GET /x: response 200 (application/json) may now be integer \| string (was string).

### Does not fire: number → integer

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: number}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
